title: AS2: switch fall-through corrupts AVM1 stack (spurious ActionPop)
description: When case N falls through to case N+1 (no break), the fall-through ActionJump patches to bodyStart — which is BEFORE case N+1's discriminant-popping ActionPop (0x17). In the match path the discriminant is still on the stack when entering a case body, so ActionPop is needed. In the fall-through path the discriminant was already consumed by the prior case's pop, so arriving before another ActionPop consumes an unrelated stack value, corrupting subsequent code. Fix: fall-through jumps should skip the ActionPop and land directly at the case body statements, not at bodyStart. Track a separate 'bodyBodyStart' position (after the ActionPop) as the fall-through target. Location: packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts:1071 in the switch compilation.
